verdict.rationale: The IRS is a government service rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no MCP server at all. Probes found no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no OpenAPI spec, and the only machine channels (MeF XML, IRIS A2A) are credentialed e-file rails, not MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
